status.description: fixed = you edited files and believe the bug is resolved; cannot_fix = root cause not found or fix not safe; needs_info = the reporter must answer something first

summary.description: Plain-English summary for the Discord thread: cause and fix, no code.

details.description: Technical notes for Jamie: root cause, what changed and why, anything uncertain.

files_changed.description: Paths relative to the working directory.

test_steps.description: How a tester confirms the fix in game.

scenario.description: Optional, only when status is fixed: one Gherkin Scenario (no Feature: line) that reproduces the bug as a regression test, tags @issue-<threadId> @regression @<resource> on the line above Scenario:, every step matching exactly one pattern in kora_qa/shared/steps.json (see fix-system.md). Saved by the fixer as <resource>/tests/issue-<threadId>.feature. Empty string or omitted when there is none.

resource.description: Resource folder the option was added to.

default.description: Default value as written in the config file.

description.description: One-line comment explaining what it does.

config_options.description: New config options this change was gated behind (see fix-system.md rule 7). Empty if the change needed no new option.
